purpose: Translate the ten scenario cards into a dated, accountable and reversible start gate without claiming a field pilot.

start_policy.earliest_start_rule: A scenario may enter a reversible pilot only after its P0 evidence is dated, its accountable roles accept the human fallback, and its scenario-specific checks pass.
start_policy.date_rule: No start date is assigned in this concept package. An authorised organisation must record the date, evidence revision and stop reviewer before any pilot request.
shared_stop: a protected group loses an equivalent route

scenarios.plain_language_zh: 把同一时段、相近入口的企业需求合并成候选接驳，同时不挤占居民公共路线。
start_when: P0 evidence is dated
the operator and curb owner accept a reversible window
a human and public-transport return-home path is published
stop_if: shuttle occupies a fire or accessible route
resident conflict has no response owner
headway or vehicle evidence is absent
scenarios.human_fallback: public transport plus telephone or on-site human dispatch

scenarios.plain_language_zh: 比较公共交通支持是否真的让员工多一种可接受的到岗方式，不把补贴写成必然的客流转移。
start_when: grouped baseline is dated
the benefit rule has a responsible owner and exit date
employees retain a non-digital and non-participating route
stop_if: benefit cannot be used by an accessibility group
public transport capacity is not checked
the comparison is presented as a measured impact without a baseline
scenarios.human_fallback: ordinary fare purchase, telephone information and staffed station assistance

scenarios.plain_language_zh: 夜间班次变少或接驳失败时，先保证有人接手，再谈自动派车。
start_when: night demand and service window are dated
a named person accepts missed-connection calls
the ground return route is tested on paper and in a professional safety review
stop_if: the last trip has no staffed fallback
a person is left at an unsafe transfer
night response time is unknown and no conservative limit is set
scenarios.human_fallback: telephone dispatch, staffed handover and public transport where available

scenarios.plain_language_zh: 让货运和维护有时间窗，但不能把预约路缘变成消防、步行或无障碍通道的障碍。
start_when: each curb asset has an owner and time window
a person can clear the space at the deadline
emergency and accessible routes are independently signed off
stop_if: loading remains after the window
an exception has no response owner
a route is blocked or a reservation cannot be audited
scenarios.human_fallback: manual booking, on-site human marshal, ordinary public curb rules and public transport

scenarios.plain_language_zh: 就医和照护出行先保留人工、电话和公共交通入口，不能要求居民先注册或交出轨迹。
start_when: the service type and window are aggregated and dated
a human service desk accepts requests and cancellations
the same route is available without an app
stop_if: care or wheelchair assistance is only promised by automation
a resident cannot exit without penalty
personal data is requested beyond the published purpose
scenarios.human_fallback: community service desk, telephone, paper request and public transport

scenarios.plain_language_zh: 先证明连续无障碍路线没有被停车、装卸和换乘切断，再比较推荐路线。
start_when: a qualified accessibility review is dated
each handover point has an owner
the route can be completed without an app or unstaffed barrier
stop_if: any forced detour is not recorded
a lift, ramp or crossing is unavailable without fallback
the worst group falls below the declared design target
scenarios.human_fallback: staffed assistance, telephone coordination and a verified public route

scenarios.plain_language_zh: 把地铁或公交下车后的最后一段和站口冲突一起核对，不只优化车上的时间。
start_when: station and last-leg counts are dated
the transfer owner accepts the route and buffer
a human wayfinding and public-transport fallback is visible
stop_if: the feeder shifts people onto an unsafe crossing
bicycle or curb storage blocks the path
transfer reliability is claimed without observed counts
scenarios.human_fallback: staffed wayfinding, ordinary rail/bus transfer and telephone information

scenarios.plain_language_zh: 活动日把访客、居民回家、物流和应急路线分开排演，不能只看总人数有没有下降。
start_when: event demand is a dated range, not a single invented count
an event safety lead accepts the plan
resident, logistics and emergency routes are shown together
stop_if: emergency access is not continuously available
residents have no exit route
crowd or curb conflict cannot be assigned to a person
scenarios.human_fallback: on-site stewarding, ordinary public transport and event cancellation or reduction

scenarios.plain_language_zh: 雨雪、断网或错过衔接时先切到安全状态，AI 不可用也不能让人失去回家和求助入口。
start_when: the four tabletop requests pass locally
a named person can take over each state
a public or human route remains available during the disruption
stop_if: the air candidate is used to fill a ground evidence gap
no one can receive the request
a protected group loses a safe route
scenarios.human_fallback: on-site staff, telephone or paper dispatch and rail/bus ground service

scenarios.plain_language_zh: 每次投诉都要能找到受理人、处理时间和复核结果，不能把“已提交”当作问题解决。
start_when: the complaint channel is public and non-digital access exists
every category has an accountable role
closure requires evidence and an independent review date
stop_if: a complaint has no owner or status update
a repair removes an accessible route
personal details are published or retained without purpose
scenarios.human_fallback: staffed desk, telephone, paper log and ordinary maintenance escalation

boundary: All entries are proposed checks. They do not establish a field pilot, resident validation, operator agreement, permit, budget, procurement, safety approval or local performance.
